review.en: Tinariwen, a Tuareg collective of guitarists and singers from the Sahara, made this album with the producer Justin Adams. Circling electric guitars, hand percussion and call-and-response singing in Tamasheq carry songs of exile, homeland and hardship. It brought the group a large international audience and made the desert guitar sound a reference for musicians from Mali and Niger to Europe and America.
review.zh: Tinariwen 是来自撒哈拉的图阿雷格吉他手与歌手的集体，这张专辑由贾斯汀·亚当斯制作。盘旋的电吉他、手鼓和塔马舍克语的一唱众和，承载着流亡、故土与艰难的歌。它为乐队带来大批国际听众，也让这种沙漠吉他之声成为从马里、尼日尔到欧美许多音乐人的参照。
